work.name: Augmodo
work.summary: Improving open world computer vision pipelines for real-world deployments in retail.
highlights: Mainly collaborating with Sacha Hu, Senior Computer Vision Scientist.
Developing uncertainty-aware computer vision models to improve accuracy and robustness in real-world deployments.
Collaborating on end-to-end pipeline development to handle millions of images per day.

work.name: Michelin
work.summary: Developing conformal and adaptive soft sensors for real-time quality prediction in multistage industrial processes.
highlights: Supervised by Dr. Sylvain Desroziers, Dr. Maxime Moreaud, and Guillaume Ramelet.
Developed torchsom , a reference PyTorch library for Self-Organizing Maps.
Designing and implementing online strategies for online quality monitoring.
Building uncertainty quantification methods, conformal prediction-based, applied to online and realt-time settings.

work.name: Adaptive & Intelligent Robotics Lab (AIRL)
work.summary: Model-based uncertainty quantification for quality-diversity optimization in robotic environments.
highlights: Supervised by Pr. Antoine Cully.
Improved data efficiency and noise robustness of MAP-Elites by incorporating a probabilistic model-based approach.
Developed new metrics for assessing uncertainty quantification in quality-diversity algorithms and non-deterministic environments.

work.name: Centre National de la Recherche Scientifique (CNRS)
work.summary: Detection of pathological oscillations in epilepsy using signal processing and convolutional neural networks.
highlights: Supervised by Dr. Ludovic Gardy, Pr. Christophe Hurter, and Pr. Emmanuel Barbeau.
Accelerated signal and image processing pipelines by 15% through Cython optimization for faster analysis of pathological oscillations in epilepsy.
Engineered 7 NoSQL databases to manage and analyze large-scale EEG data at both macro and micro scales, improving data accessibility and query performance.
Enhanced classification model performance by 5% through systematic fine-tuning and hyperparameter optimization.
Leveraged Grad-CAM to improve model explainability, ensuring predictions aligned with underlying neurophysiological biomarkers.

work.name: EuroMoov Digital Health in Motion (DHM)
work.summary: Design of an image filter for narrow contour detection and multi-scale adaptation using machine learning.
highlights: Supervised by Pr. Baptiste Magnier and Pr. Binbin Xu.
Developed a novel 2D filter for detecting adjacent and multi-scale ridges in images, leading to a publication in IEEE ICASSP 2023.
Implemented and benchmarked state-of-the-art edge detection models (e.g., DexiNed, RCF) as part of a comparative analysis for contour detection.
